# YeahSight

> YeahSight gives a clear, structured view of how society works and where it is heading. It covers four domains: environment & energy, economy & equity, technology & automation, and social organization, and ends with a proposed roadmap for society. YeahSight is an initiative of HappyBein, a Dutch foundation (Stichting) based in Eindhoven whose idea is that structured understanding unlocks solutions. All articles are available in English and French.

## Start here

- [Foresight Trends](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/foresight-trends/): what foresight is and an overview of all trend areas
- [Vision & Roadmap](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/vision-roadmap/): the six proposed steps towards a fairer, safer world

## Environment & Energy

- [Earth Land — View per Individual](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/environment-energy/earth-land-view-per-individual/): global land use broken down per person
- [Fair Space Sharing](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/environment-energy/fair-space-sharing/): a proposal for sharing land between humans and wildlife
- [Clean & Safe Energy](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/environment-energy/clean-safe-energy/): energy sources compared, and the path to renewables
- [Plant-Based Consumption](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/environment-energy/plant-based-consumption/): how diet connects to land, climate and animal welfare

## Economy & Equity

- [Universal Allowance](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/economy-equity/universal-allowance/): a guaranteed, purpose-bound budget for basic needs
- [The Economical System](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/economy-equity/the-economical-system/): how economic systems work and shape outcomes
- [Fair Globe Sharing](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/economy-equity/fair-globe-sharing/): what a fair distribution of the world's resources could look like
- [Inheritance](https://yeahsight.happybein.com/economy-equity/inheritance/): how inheritance carries inequity forward, and a proposal for redistribution
